_: Companions walk with you (one active + the pup). Each unlocks an ability only while they're in the party. Recruited through story beats; feelings matter: turning one down or picking another over them sets `bitter`, which can send them to the Dark Crystal later (see decisions).

penguin_m.name: Pip-Pip
penguin_m.ability_desc: Tap ♥: a crystal aura that stuns grumps nearby and lifts your mana by 5.
penguin_m.join: I touched it first. Nova says she did. Together is warmer. And I'll carry the snacks.

penguin_f.name: Nova
penguin_f.ability_desc: A penguin-cat purr-wave: Grumps caught in it remember they were crystals and float home; other creatures he squeezed turn back into what they were (rank 1: little ones; each rank reaches bigger ones).
penguin_f.join: Fine. But I'm the one who talks to the cats.
penguin_f.ability_desc_wait: Nova feels the star crystal's warmth, but nobody has shown her how to let it out. Catkins, in the crystal meadow, can teach it.
penguin_f.wait_line: Nova: 'It's in here, warm, like a purr. But it won't come out. That purring past the east meadow: whoever it is knows how.'
penguin_f.wait_line_old: Nova: 'What I did before was an accident, and now it's gone quiet. I need someone to teach me properly. That purring in the crystal meadow...'

dad.name: Dad
dad.ability_desc: Trees fall twice as fast and give 2 more wood while he's with you.
dad.join: Somebody has to carry the wood.

mom.name: Mom
mom.ability_desc: Heals 1 health every 10 s while she's close.
mom.join: I'll come. Someone has to make sure you eat.

pax.name: Pax
pax.ability_desc: Runs ahead: hidden forage and ore within 10 cells are marked; +15% run speed.
pax.join: I know every shortcut. Most of them are through fences.

kairi.name: Kairi
kairi.ability_desc: Crafting is 30% faster; tap ♥ to open your bag anywhere.
kairi.join: I can fix the resonator. Probably. Let's find out.

big_jim.name: Big Jim
big_jim.ability_desc: Tap ♥ facing a rock, log or stump: he breaks it himself, no tool needed.
big_jim.join: You pay, I swing. You don't pay, I still swing, I just complain.

mer.name: Mer
mer.ability_desc: The merkitties' gift: a tail in any water. Swim and dive anywhere.
mer.join: You came down the dark stair with a lantern and no fear. That's rarer than crystal. Come on, the water's warmer than it looks.

sal.name: Sal
sal.ability_desc: Tap ♥: he sells your most valuable stack of loot (drops, ore, treasure) at 120%.
sal.join: I know people. People who know people. Keep your head down.

coldy.name: Coldy
coldy.desc: Leader of the crystal babies and keeper of the sacred key. Stamps a ring that cracks the ground.

lines.recruit: Yes. I understand. We babies know you are good. I come with you, for I hold the sacred key.
idle: Bee bop boo baby. That means: be careful.
Mountain is tall. Top is in space. We walk.
Finargle not bad because fuzzy. Finargle bad because listen to wrong voice.
Old finargles sing to mountain. Mountain sing back. Now quiet.
If eyes in dark, Coldy stamp. Finargle hate stamp.
lines.gate: I hold the key. Key goes where you go.

coldy.ability_desc: Tap ♥: Coldy stamps a ring that cracks the ground and staggers everything close.

mk_kit.name: Kit
mk_kit.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: Blows everything back and puts the wind at your heels. (6 mana)
mk_kit.join: Okay. But I'm not slow. You're slow.

mk_ember.name: Ember
mk_ember.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: A ring of fire: burns everything close. (8 mana)
mk_ember.join: Nothing burns unless you say so. Deal.

mk_dahlia.name: Dahlia
mk_dahlia.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: Roots hold everything near in place. (7 mana)
mk_dahlia.join: Fine. I'll keep your roads open instead of shut.

mk_juno.name: Juno
mk_juno.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: A bolt down the line you face. (8 mana)
mk_juno.join: I'll keep your lights on. All of them.

mk_rio.name: Rio
mk_rio.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: Two pulses, on the beat, through everything near. (7 mana)
mk_rio.join: I'll keep time for you. Nobody falls out of step.

mk_mei.name: Mei
mk_mei.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: A roll of the dice: crystals, health, or a hard hit. (6 mana)
mk_mei.join: Heads, I'm in. Tails, also in.

mk_bruno.name: Bruno
mk_bruno.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: Iron skin: hits land much softer for a while. (8 mana)
mk_bruno.join: You waited for me. I'll wait for you.

mk_tomas.name: Teo
mk_tomas.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: A flash of mirrors: everything near is dazed. (7 mana)
mk_tomas.join: Okay. Somebody should look out for you from forty floors up.

mk_sable.name: Sable
mk_sable.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: Step into shadow: nothing can touch you for three seconds. (9 mana)
mk_sable.join: I'll drive. Quietly. You'll never hear me coming, and neither will they.

mk_atlas.name: Atlas
mk_atlas.ability_desc: Tap the ♥ partner button: Drags everything near to your feet and hits it. (8 mana)
mk_atlas.join: Fine. Everything comes to me in the end. Even friends, apparently.

partner_scene._: Chapter 1: on day 2 (penguins, the morning after the crystal lands) / day 3 (gangsters) a scene at the farm gate offers a partner from the characters you didn't pick. farm.gd reads when.day. Penguin arc: a penguin must be among the offers (both if you're not a penguin; the other if you are).

lines.text: Someone at the gate. Snow on their shoulders, though it isn't snowing.
We touched it. Last night. In YOUR field, while everybody else hid. Now everything hums.
He means: can we stay. One of us, anyway. The other keeps watch over the island, in case the red sky comes back.
Pip-Pip's keeping watch over the island, in case the red sky comes back. Someone here needs a hand. Can I stay?
Nova's keeping watch over the island. I'm the other one. I'm also the better one. Can I stay?
Penguins. The Two Too Powerful Penguins, by the look of the frost on the gate.
The air around them hums faintly, like a purr you feel more than hear. Whatever power the crystal gave them, nobody has taught them to use all of it yet.
A truck at the gate, engine ticking. Two people lean on it like they've been waiting since before the sun.
Boss. Word is you're setting up out here. Word is also that the President's man was in the meadow.
One of us comes with you. The other watches the road. That's how we did it in the river cities.

decisions._: Choices that change the ending. Each sets flags; endings.json reads them.
decisions.partner_refused: A companion you turned down twice becomes bitter: after day 20 they leave for the east and show up at the Dark Crystal's side in chapter 5.
decisions.gangster_shops: Each gangster shop you fund in town (hideout chapter) moves one villager out (Posy, then Lumi, then Juniper) and brings one more thug patrol to the avenues at night.
decisions.orchard_cleared: Clearing the orchard for Rook keeps the north bridge safe; leaving it lets grumps reach the clinic by chapter 4.
decisions.bell: Ringing the town bell (gold clapper) calls every villager to the plaza for the final fight.
